config_provenance: Versioned configurations accompanying this plan; verify listed SHA-256 values before launch. Record configuration commit separately from the unchanged engine source.

later_timing.lengths: Only the prespecified lengths with all ten feasible conditions; retain excluded-length failures in capacity results.
later_timing.freeze_after: Review measured elapsed/memory by condition at each feasible length.
later_timing.cell_timeout_rule: max(30, ceil(3 * maximum feasibility cell seconds at that length))
later_timing.process_hard_limit_rule: max(600, ceil(6 * sum feasibility cell seconds at that length + 300))
later_timing.slurm_rule: Round process hard limit plus 120 seconds upward to the next five-minute boundary.
later_timing.summary: All three repetitions; median and range, with first-use timing shown separately if different. No task-level confidence interval.
